# Invictus AI

> AI-powered patient growth systems built exclusively for dental clinics in India.

Invictus AI is a specialized dental marketing agency that helps dental clinics acquire more patients through website design, Meta ads, Google review automation, and AI chatbots.

## Services

- [Clinic Website Design](/services/clinic-website): High-converting, mobile-first dental clinic websites with local SEO and WhatsApp integration. Starts at ₹7,000.
- [Meta Ads & Content](/services/meta-ads): Hyper-local Instagram and Facebook ad campaigns targeted within 5km of your clinic. Starts at ₹8,000/mo.
- [AI Website Chatbot](/services/ai-chatbot): 24/7 AI receptionist that answers patient questions and books appointments on your website. ₹3,000/mo.
- [Reputation Management](/services/reputation-management): Automated 5-star Google review collection via WhatsApp with negative feedback filtering. ₹3,000/mo.
